title: KVR Audio Marketplace
summary: Long-established VST marketplace platform for plugin distribution.
description:
## Overview

KVR Audio is a long-established platform (founded early 2000s) containing tens of thousands of audio software products from 3700+ developers.

## Key Features for Developers

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **KVR DIRECT** | Sell directly with complete license code inventory control |
| **License Silo** | Simple, secure license code management system |
| **No fees for sellers** | Dealer margin covers everything; developers pay no fees |
| **Digital Distribution** | Integration with Xchange Market Platform, Plugivery, Ilio |
| **Product Database** | Products must first be onboarded to KVR database |

## Sales Model

- Sell license codes or unprotected content
- KVR hosts installers under 128MB
- Larger files: use PRIVATE DOWNLOAD URL function
- Support for promotions and discount scheduling

## Marketplace URL

https://www.kvraudio.com/marketplace/

## Onboarding

1. Add product to KVR Product Database
2. Apply for KVR DIRECT seller account
3. Set up license code inventory
4. Configure pricing and promotions
